situation: Writing the merge-gate mutation plan tests/fixtures/mutations/i<N>.json for a Playwright (command runner) target, where one regression spec locks changes in more than one file.
right_direction: Declare one repair with one change per file (revert the label in HTML, empty the JS handler rather than delete the element); nodeid is the spec file; choose a message that appears only when every change is caught, such as the exact 'N failed' count derived from which tests each change breaks; run the draft with --report and read the mutated output before fixing the message.
anti_pattern: Using a test title as the message (it also appears when that test passes); a message that only one of the changes produces; deleting the whole button so presence-only tests carry the proof.
